description: This file defines the class ConfigTranslationFormAccess, which manages access control for translation forms in Drupal's configuration translation module. It extends functionality to check permissions based on language lock status and language identity.

classes.name: ConfigTranslationFormAccess
classes.description: A class that manages access control for translation form operations, extending overview access checks with additional language lock and identity validations.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access to translation forms based on route, user account, and language code, handling exceptions related to language mapping.

methods.name: doCheckAccess
methods.description: Performs detailed access validation, ensuring target language is not locked and not the same as the source language.
